ValidationRule.description: Agent should not be able to close a case without the information of the product in Quality complaint.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), OR( AND(Product__c==null,DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) >= DATE(2023,03,28)), AND(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) <= DATE(2023,03,27), Product__c==null, Other_Product_Information__c ==null) ), ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Closed'), RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Quality", OR(ISPICKVAL(Reason , 'Product'), ISPICKVAL(Reason , 'Package'), ISPICKVAL( NA1_Category_Level_3__c , 'Reaction')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product Name cannot be blank. Please select "Dummy Product" if product is unknown.
